narration: [unclear opening words] America's getting ready for something nobody will name.
motion_note: Hook: already moving; push in on the masked Watcher lit by the phone

narration: Tomorrow, 2:20 PM.
motion_note: Push into the clock face, settle on the hands

narration: Every TV and every radio in America gets interrupted. All at once.
motion_note: Drift over the sofa and land on the static TV

narration: A nationwide test. First one in three years. Now look at the week leading up to it.
motion_note: Push toward the cracked phone held out to camera

narration: Wednesday. Casablanca goes black. The storm takes out four power lines. All four, including the backups.
motion_note: Slow push from storm sky toward the coastline and the red glow

narration: Thursday. Microsoft email goes down around the world.
motion_note: Push down the aisle, settle on the figure facing the sad-face monitors

narration: Same day, Jensen Huang, the man behind the chips that run AI, walks away from his own company. [...] suspected Chinese spy.
motion_note: Drift off the empty chair, land on the chip on the desk

narration: Friday the 13th. 12:30 PM, New Orleans.
motion_note: Slow pull back to reveal the riverboat at the dock; let it read

narration: The tanker's steering locks. It slams straight into a cruise ship [full of?] old people.
motion_note: Tilt up from the riverboat to the red ship looming over it; hold the reveal

narration: The boat rolls onto its side. A hundred people in the Mississippi. Somehow, nobody died.
motion_note: Start on the capsized riverboat, settle down onto the swimmers and life rings

narration: And they still don't know why the steering failed.
motion_note: Push into the empty wheelhouse, land on the wheel

narration: Three and a half hours later, the FAA stops every departing plane in America. "Extraordinary circumstances."
motion_note: Push past the traveler toward the red departure boards

narration: Three thousand five hundred planes already in the sky.
motion_note: Push over the operator's shoulder into the green map

narration: Their answer? A router.
motion_note: Push into the router and its single green light

narration: Today, people couldn't get into their bank accounts.
motion_note: Push toward the ATM screen full of static

narration: [Then?] a fake clip of Donald Trump saying the power goes out for ninety days. [unclear]
motion_note: Push into the waveform on the Watcher's phone

narration: Millions shared it anyway.
motion_note: Pull back from one phone to reveal the swarm of phones

narration: Why is the Pentagon getting bases ready to survive ninety days with no grid?
motion_note: Slow push toward the base gate

narration: Why are the people running this country moving into those places?
motion_note: Push toward the soldier at the checkpoint

narration: Marco Rubio [unclear]. Last week [unclear]. Threats. They won't say what kind.
motion_note: Drift right and land on the one lit window

narration: Europe. Nineteen planes hit with bomb threats in one day. Fighter jets riding next to passengers.
motion_note: Push past the passenger to the object outside the window

narration: Three hundred schools in Italy emptied. No bombs. Nobody caught.
motion_note: Push toward the children walking in under umbrellas

narration: [unclear place], Mexico. A camera catches something. [Four feet tall?]
motion_note: Night-vision plate; near-still so 024 can match-cut on the same framing

narration: No hair. Long fingers. A tail.
motion_note: Matched cut from 023 (same framing): creature appears, then push in and HOLD so it reads

narration: Two weeks later, same city, a security camera films something huge flying over the rooftops.
motion_note: Push up to the winged shape over the rooftops (archival look)

narration: People are calling it a pterodactyl. Experts say a heron. And parts of the video were faked.
motion_note: Push toward the glitching creature's head; hold

narration: So why [unclear] is it always [unclear]?
motion_note: Empty farm path; push along the wall toward the horizon glow

narration: [unclear] Mexico City. A light sits over the skyline. Then it's gone.
motion_note: Rooftop watcher; push past him up to the single light in the sky

narration: [unclear] red flashes over France. Alien invasion? Not quite. [unclear] And people swear they saw tentacles.
motion_note: Tilt up from the village to the red tendrils in the sky; let it read

narration: Black shapes streak past airplane windows.
motion_note: Plane window; push into the dark shape against the red horizon

narration: They seem to show up before something big happens.
motion_note: Past the passenger to the dark shape over the clouds

narration: Donald Trump says pilots told him something up there moves three times faster than our jets.
motion_note: Cockpit: push toward the streak of light

narration: And today, Mayor Zohran Mamdani shut down the NYPD unit that polices protests.
motion_note: Empty locker room; land on the helmet on the bench

narration: In March, someone threw homemade bombs outside his house.
motion_note: Push into the seated Watcher's mask

narration: Every single one of these has an explanation. So [unclear] nobody's telling us the whole thing?
motion_note: Pull back from one Watcher to reveal the rows of Watchers; hold

narration: Tomorrow at 2:20, every screen screams at once.
motion_note: Push to the cracked phone in the Watcher's hand

narration: The voice tells you it's only a test.
